name: dotnet-channels

`System.Threading.Channels`: thread-safe producer/consumer queues, back-pressure, `IAsyncEnumerable<T>`, graceful shutdown. Hosted services: [skill:dotnet-background-services]; async/cancellation: [skill:dotnet-csharp-async-patterns].

`Channel<T>` provides `ChannelWriter<T>` and `ChannelReader<T>`; it handles synchronization. Bounded: `Channel.CreateBounded<T>(capacity)` caps memory; `FullMode` controls overflow. Unbounded: `Channel.CreateUnbounded<T>()` grows without limit and can exhaust memory under load. Use bounded channels for production/untrusted producer rates; unbounded for guaranteed-low-volume workloads or prototyping.

Unbounded -- use only when you control the producer rate.

`FullMode`: `Wait` (default) blocks `WriteAsync` until space is available; `DropOldest` suits telemetry; `DropNewest` suits rate limiting; `DropWrite` discards the attempted write and makes `TryWrite` return `false`.
